name: hexhaven
description: Hexhaven - an open-source, original-art 3D hex settlement strategy game with authoritative online multiplayer.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
